info.title: Lever Jobs Scraper — New Job Postings Since Any Date
info.description:
Scrape Lever jobs and job postings from any Lever job board, only those created since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, team, workplace type, URL, description. Pay per result.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/lever-jobs-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/lever-jobs-scraper
Author: Public Records.
